name: UK energy price cap
summary: Cap £1,723 a year; Cornwall Insight forecasts £1,999 for January, a 16% rise; no newer forecast found by 13 Nov
state: Ofgem's cap for October to December 2026 is £1,723 a year for a typical dual-fuel household. Cornwall Insight forecasts £1,999.28 for January to March 2027, a rise of £276 or about 16%, inside the 5–20% Watch band (Cornwall Insight, 30 Sep). Searches on 13 Nov found no newer Cornwall Insight forecast; Ofgem is due to announce the January cap in late November.
for_you: A rise of this size would add around £276 a year to a typical dual-fuel bill from January. Households on standard variable tariffs and those on prepayment meters are most exposed; Ofgem and Citizens Advice publish guidance on help with energy bills.
rubric_hit: Watch: cap £1,723 in £1,700–2,200 band; forecast rise 16% (≥5%, below 20% Alert)

sources.title: Cornwall Insight — 16% Price Cap Rise Forecast in January

why: The Ofgem cap sets bills for most UK households — a direct cost-of-living signal.
drivers: Wholesale gas and power prices, network costs, policy levies.

rubric.normal: Typical dual-fuel cap < £1,700/yr and next forecast change < +5%.
